column5: The injected SelectResponseIter now has a bounded raw-Datum RecordSet adapter with stored metadata and idempotent lifecycle state; text formatting remains at the server write boundary. Full executor construction, panic recovery, found-rows accounting, CTE cleanup, SQL killer publication, detach, and concurrent external Finish remain open.

The connection response attempts Finish before exactly one Close on success and every error path, without repeating Finish after a Finish attempt. The transferred AuthChallenge/AuthSessionAttempt boundary still preserves identity, plugin, authentication bytes, salt, password presence, and the auth_socket precondition. Transaction commit/rollback, slow logging, statement context cleanup, cursor detach, session-side finishStmt, identity lookup, credential verification, account locking, roles, and authenticated publication remain open.

The server consumes a lazy RecordSet through bounded Next, stored Columns, Finish, and Close contracts; Rust mutable ownership serializes these operations and retains metadata after close. Go's cross-goroutine finishLock/TryLock behavior, prepared column cache, RUv2 cursor tracking, and cursor wrappers remain open.
